name: bar_removed_1
prompt: This is an upscaled crop of a photoreal audio-plugin UI. Output ONE image, landscape 1536x1024, with EXACTLY the same framing, scale, perspective, lighting, colours and every detail as the input, so it overlays the input pixel for pixel. Change ONLY this: remove the chrome cylindrical tone bar (the slide bar lying across the strings in the middle of the black fretboard) and its reflection/shadow completely. The strings, fret lines, fret dots/diamonds, printed fret numbers and wood continue naturally and evenly through where the bar was. Everything outside that change must stay identical to the input.
